task.title: Troubleshoot an unavailable documentation portal
task.shortdesc: Collect the visible /help/ state and deployment evidence when the installed documentation portal is unavailable.

prereq.p: Use this procedure when an installed BPM instance reports a missing, stale, incompatible, incomplete, or not-found state at /help/.

context.p: The documentation portal is part of the BPM interface. Its availability depends on the installed documentation artifact matching the running BPM version; BPM does not repair a missing or incompatible artifact at runtime.

step.cmd: Record the portal URL and visible state.

info.p: Capture the full /help/ URL, locale, browser message, BPM version, and time of the failure. Keep the response separate from FastAPI /docs and /openapi.json, which are different interfaces.

step.cmd: Confirm the running BPM instance and its documentation setting.

info.p: Record the process host, port, source revision or deployed release identifier, and BPM_DOCUMENTATION_SITE_DIR value without copying secrets.

step.cmd: Stop dependent documentation actions when the state is not ready.

info.note: Do not treat a missing or incompatible portal as a working help system, and do not hand-edit installed files to bypass the state.

step.cmd: Escalate the evidence to the BPM deployment owner.

info.p: Provide the portal URL, visible state, BPM version, documentation-site setting name, process logs, and the time of the observation. The deployment owner can restore a matching documentation artifact through the maintained documentation procedure.
After the deployment owner restores a matching artifact, reopen /help/ and the affected contextual help routes.

result.p: The operator has enough evidence to distinguish an unavailable documentation artifact from the BPM API and to request the correct recovery.

postreq.p: Record the recovered portal state with the original escalation evidence.
